decision.what: root cause: ux/Dictate/Widget.js's Thread (the class both the Dictate page and the sheet build through ux/Dictate/chat.js) sets scrollTop on `this.$bubbles.el` in draw()/draw_ask()/show_stream()/split_paragraph() — a plain non-scrolling child div. The real scroll box is the Thread view's OWN element (`this.el`, class ux-dictate-widget-thread, overflow-y:auto in Widget.css). Setting scrollTop on the wrong element is a no-op, so neither surface has ever auto-scrolled. ext/Chat/Chat.js's own chat() factory already has correct lock/scroll/ResizeObserver logic on the right element (doc/scroll.md) but no jump-to-bottom button — nothing in ext/Chat has one today.
decision.alternative: hand-roll a second lock/scroll/button pair inside Widget.js, duplicating Chat.js's logic — rejected, CLAUDE.md law 6 (one of everything). Instead: factor Chat.js's existing smart-scroll block into one exported `sticky_scroll(box)` helper (adds the jump-to-bottom button too), have chat() call it (no behavior change), and have Widget.Thread + ThreadV1 call the SAME helper on `this.el` instead of the broken $bubbles.el line. One scroll behavior, three callers.

log.msg: code + docs complete. Summary of the fix: ext/Chat/Chat.js exports a new `sticky_scroll(box)` (lock/scroll/ResizeObserver + a `.chatbox-jump` down-arrow button, moved to the end of `box` on every jump so it never lands in `.chatbox-log > :first-child`'s push-to-bottom spot). chat() now calls it instead of its own hand-rolled copy (no behavior change there — same logic, one owner). ux/Dictate/Widget.js's Thread and ThreadV1 (what ux/Dictate/chat.js builds for both the Dictate page and the ✦ sheet) now call the SAME sticky_scroll(this.el) and use scroll.pin() everywhere they used to set `this.$bubbles.el.scrollTop` (the actual bug — this.el is the real overflow-y:auto box, not $bubbles). Chat.css and Widget.css each get one new `position: relative` line so the button has a containing block, plus Chat.css's new `.chatbox-jump` button style (shared by both surfaces, since Widget.js already loads Chat.css). Self-verified by re-reading every changed region twice end to end (no tool to run `node --check` in this session) — no leftover references to the old locked/last/down/at_bottom variables or the broken $bubbles.el.scrollTop calls anywhere in either file.
